tools.name: search-events
tools.description: Search upcoming public aviation events on Events.Aero (airshows, fly-ins, workshops and more). Filter by free text, event type, country, date range, distance from a point, free entry or online events. Results are ordered by start date, or by distance when latitude and longitude are given, one page a

tools.name: get-event
tools.description: Get one public event by its sqid or slug (from search-events or featured-events): dates, venue, price, how to book or RSVP, organiser contact details shown on the event page, flying in (PPR, runway, landing fees and whether pilots can RSVP to fly in), the day's schedule and the description. tools.name: featured-events
tools.description: The events Events.Aero is featuring right now, the same selection as the lead row of the home page, optionally for one country. Each includes its public event page URL.

tools.name: list-event-types
tools.description: The kinds of aviation event on Events.Aero (airshow, fly-in, workshop and so on), with the value to pass to search-events and the public page that lists each type in a country.

tools.name: list-countries
tools.description: The countries Events.Aero lists events in, with the code to pass to other tools and each country's public home and events pages.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "events" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search-events, get-event · Private data: get-event · Public sink: search-events, get-event.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search-events, get-event · Private data: get-event · Public sink: search-events, get-event

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
